name: Zacess High Contrast Dark
description: White on black with strong borders and a yellow focus ring, for the highest contrast on a dark screen.
toml:
# the Zacess High Contrast Dark theme as a profile, one of the ten starter profiles
# colours from the Zacess themes palette 0.12.1

spec_version = 1
name = "Zacess High Contrast Dark"
id = "zacess-high-contrast-dark"
description = "White on black with strong borders and a yellow focus ring, for the highest contrast on a dark screen."
appearance = "dark"

[needs]
reduce_motion = true
cursor_size = "standard"
focus_ring_width_px = 2

[needs.contrast]
text = 7.0
non_text = 3.0
overlay = 4.5
terminal = 7.0
terminal_dim = 4.5
highlight_distance = 0.08
colour_vision_distance = 0.04
tone_difference = 0.05

[needs.font]
family = "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono"
fallback = "monospace"
size_pt = 14

[palette]
background = "#000000"
foreground = "#ffffff"
surface = "#000000"
surface_alt = "#0f0f0f"
muted = "#e0e0e0"
border = "#a6a6a6"
accent = "#f5c400"
accent_foreground = "#000000"
link = "#8fd0ff"
focus_ring = "#f5c400"
cursor = "#f5c400"
cursor_text = "#000000"
selection_background = "#bf96ff"
selection_foreground = "#000000"
selection_soft = "#6501ae"
line_highlight = "#262626"
error = "#ff9e94"
warning = "#ffd28a"
info = "#a9d4ff"

[palette.syntax]
keyword = "#f5c400"
control = "#ffcdf0"
function = "#8fd0ff"
type = "#00f4e0"
variable = "#ffffff"
parameter = "#ffcf9e"
property = "#c9a8ff"
string = "#20fe34"
number = "#ffb27a"
comment = "#c7b404"
operator = "#ffffff"
tag = "#f5c400"
attribute = "#fff0b8"
regex = "#ffa6c9"
invalid = "#ff9e94"
added = "#3bff59"
removed = "#ffaba3"
changed = "#e6f2ff"

[palette.terminal]
ansi = [
    "#b3b3b3", "#ff9e94", "#26f444", "#f5c400",
    "#8fd0ff", "#f2a6ff", "#00f4e0", "#e0e0e0",
    "#cccccc", "#ffc4bd", "#95ff98", "#ffe08a",
    "#c8e6ff", "#ffcdf7", "#56fff3", "#ffffff",
]

check.output:
pass profiles/zacess-high-contrast-dark.toml (Zacess High Contrast Dark)
     224 pairs against text 7:1, non-text 3:1, overlay 4.5:1, terminal 7:1 and dim terminal 4.5:1, with paired colours 0.05 apart in tone and 0.04 under colour vision deficiencies
     tightest syntax.comment #c7b404 on selection_soft #6501ae: 4.59:1
